confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live prices or listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; July accommodation is the most variable and event-sensitive. Beer assumes a 0.5 L glass; a 0.3 L Seidel would price lower. Cocktail and wine come from direct knowledge of Viennese bar and wine-glass pricing rather than the beer relationship. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Vienna's cafe, Beisl, Heuriger and hotel price levels, with loose reference to other large Central European capitals.
